cleanRoom.source: Repo-owned Excel/MSForms fixture input generated through public Excel/VBIDE automation and driven with public Windows input.
cleanRoom.prohibited: No Office internals, decompilation, disassembly, non-public source, or OxForms output comparison.

notes: Two TextBoxes laid out non-overlapping so a window-bounds + fixture-layout calculation can target each control by point for a focus-changing mouse click.

Every focus, validation, change, and mouse handler on both TextBoxes logs one W008VetoClickLog row recording the relevant Cancel ReturnBoolean before/after, the post-handler focus owner, and the control's own .Text.

The Exit veto is gated on Public module flags (gVetoExit And gVetoControl = thisname) set by the per-scenario Set... macros, so one workbook covers both the non-vetoing baseline and the vetoing mouse-click scenario through the shared worksheet.
No control fonts are declared/applied (a design-time font set hangs the SaveAs dialog); no design-time Default/accelerator properties are set.
